facts.fact: NIMC encourages Nigerians to use its NINAuth app for identity authentication and consent-based sharing of personal information, with QR codes and share codes for verification (The Sun).

The NIMC Act 2026, signed 2026-06-26, establishes NIMC as Root Certification Authority for Nigeria's National Public Key Infrastructure, expected to support digital identity authentication and trusted electronic transactions (The Sun, citing NIMC).

NGA.note: The document states no link between the civil register and the ID system.

facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission, with Dr Vincent Olatunji ordering a full-scale investigation, opened an investigation in March 2024 into alleged unauthorised access to NIN data via XpressVerify.com (The Sun).

NGA.note: No ruling against a named organisation is stated; an investigation opened is not a ruling.

facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission, led by Dr Vincent Olatunji, was acting in March 2024 when it ordered an investigation into alleged unauthorised access to NIN information (The Sun).
The NDPC commenced an investigation in March 2024 into alleged unauthorised processing and monetisation of NIN data via XpressVerify.com, with no decision stated (The Sun).

NGA.note: The article names no data protection law and gives no decision.

facts.fact: President Tinubu signed the NIMC Act 2026 into law on 2026-06-26, repealing the 2007 Act (The Sun).
NIMC says the NIMC Act 2026 strengthens its mandate in identity authentication, interoperability and data protection and makes NIMC Root Certification Authority for the national PKI (The Sun).

NGA.note: Only a passing reference to a digital transformation agenda; no strategy is described.
The document gives 134.6 million enrolments and 117.5 million NINs but no population share.
Nothing on a number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the NIN is named.

facts.fact: NIMC had issued 117.5 million NINs from 134.6 million enrolments as of 2026-06-30 (The Sun's earlier reporting).

NGA.note: No biometric check or certification is stated.

facts.fact: The NIN is linked to SIM registration and bank account verification, among other services; the NCC said more than 153 million SIM cards had been linked to NINs (The Sun).
The NIN is used for SIM registration (telecoms) and bank account verification (banking) as well as government programmes, per The Sun.
The NCC disclosed more than 153 million SIM cards linked to NINs, about 96 per cent compliance at the time (The Sun).
